Here's a redesigned form for a bookshop reservation system with a labeled email field and pickup date:

```html
<form>
  <label for="email">Email Address</label>
  <input type="email" id="email" name="email" placeholder="Enter your email">

  <label for="pickup">Pickup Date</label>
  <input type="date" id="pickup" name="pickup" placeholder="Pickup date">

  <button type="submit">Reserve</button>
</form>
```

This form includes a labeled email field and a date picker for the pickup date, making it more accessible and user-friendly.
